title: Extension by zero of an integer multiplicity current essentially carried by a compact set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, V ⊆ U open, and K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with K ⊆ V. Let X ∈ 𝒟_n(V), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep of V representing X (X = τ(M, θ, ξ)) with Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0. Then there is Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that: (i) Y restricted to V equals X (Y.restrictDomain = X); (ii) spt Y ⊆ K; (iii) spt Y is compact; (iv) if ∂X = 0 in V (BoundaryVanishes X), then ∂Y = 0 in U; (v) Y is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V K : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → R.Represents X → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, Y.restrictDomain hVU = X ∧ Y.support ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ (BoundaryVanishes X → BoundaryVanishes Y) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Y
